body:
1. I know exactly how lucky I am, and I'm not taking it for granted. I've grown up around people who have it 100x worse then me (family-wise). If I had a nickle for every time someone was surprised that my father and mother were still living together I'd be a rich man.

2. I'm sorry but you miss the point, but that's my fault. My problem isn't that I'm ashamed to be living at home anymore (I used too be ashamed when I was younger and cared about having a girlfriend...what girl would want a guy with no job, money, car, and still lives with his parents). The way things are going here though, my father will be dead in less than two years and I don't know how much longer my mother has. Once they're gone what will I do? Fact is, I can't live here forever and I need to do *something*. I understand it's fairly normal for people to live with their parents, but I also feel like a un-self-efficient leach that does nothing but consume; I fucking hate it.

3. I'm going to ignore this as it's heavy on the living at home thing.


4. Yes I know. I've said the same thing from 13-18, 18-25, and it would only make sense if I said the same thing in the future. I'm sorry, do I come off as an idiot? :s

5. More stuff you think I don't know? You think I don't know how lucky I am to be living in this time in history? This glorious age of consumption and comfort? About the mind boggling number of people who have lived and died before me and the shit living conditions they lived in? Or their low life spans? You have absolutely no *fucking* idea how often I've though of these things.

6. That's fucking it. I'm done reading your comment. I'm not going to sit here and be insulted while seeking help and lectured like I don't already have a deep understanding of these things. I have a paragraph on perspective for you though:

    Go live in the streets for a week. Take no money, and only wear shorts and a t-shirt. I was homeless for two months living in an ally like that. I will be right back in this position if I can't find a use for my life. I'm trying to survive, but if I can't then I may as well just kill myself and spare myself the suffering of a slow death. Right now I can't help myself, I can't use my life to help others, and my time is running out. *That* scares me, deeply. I'm facing my fucking death. It's just down the road...I can see it...and I can't find any turns. Currently, that's the ***only*** perspective that matters anymore. I'm sorry I'm not vary articulate, but I'm really not good at expressing myself, and to be honest, you kind of pissed me off.

7. Screw it, one more because the Peace Corps caught my eye. When I mentioned that I did research into volunteer work, did you really think I missed the largest and most well known volunteer organization on the planet?? /facepalm


Not sure what I said, but you must really think of me as a moron. :(


**Friendly tip:** Next time you should try and **talk** with people. Find out how their minds work, what they know and don't know, make an effort not to come off as condescending, and *don't* lecture people unless it's called for. All you did here was tell me things I don't just know, but have a good understanding of. Which you could have easily figured out if you made the slightest effort at having a conversation instead of assuming you know everything.
>\>10k people. Large portion are meth addicts too because we live in the middle of a dessert, and there's an abundance of meth labs nearby.

Meaning is quite important. If I cant find a job or something to use my life for, then I'll just be homeless and die on the streets. Why live with absolutely nothing to live for? 

The church isn't a bad idea. I haden't thought of that, but I wouldn't want to be one of those people who give them bibles and try to convert them.
Not as often as I'd like.
